Required fields: native signal ID, tenant, definition/code, affected alias, time, evidence, mapping version
Required coverage: selected alert table/schema and source extraction healthy
Exact logic: Never admit by row existence alone; create FindingSignal and evaluate registered central finding definition
Deduplication: Exact source dedup by table/native ID/revision; central root-cause dedup later

Required fields: source aliases, candidate canonical entities, resolver scores/reasons/conflicts
Required coverage: at least two relevant sources or one unresolved high-value source observation; resolver healthy
Exact logic: Open when an active/relevant source object cannot resolve above approved threshold or has incompatible deterministic candidates; not_evaluable when resolver/coverage unavailable
Deduplication: tenant + source object/candidate set + resolution generation

Required fields: canonical candidates, aliases, matching evidence and conflicting attributes
Exact logic: Open when two canonical application records satisfy a versioned duplicate-candidate rule and are not constrained as distinct
Deduplication: tenant + ordered canonical entity pair + rule version
Action: Merge or mark distinct with evidence

Required fields: canonical tenant application, first_seen, governance/owner state, source evidence
Required coverage: expected discovery sources healthy for scope
Exact logic: New is badge during configured window; open actionable finding only when application remains unmanaged/unowned past definition threshold

Required fields: canonical tenant application, approval state, distinct canonical users/accounts and activity window
Required coverage: application and activity sources healthy; identity resolution coverage reported
Exact logic: Open when state is unapproved and distinct qualifying users >= versioned threshold in window; unknown users excluded and reported
Availability: Derivable from current evidence after canonicalization

Required coverage: activity source plus classifier and event-time application state healthy
Exact logic: Open when qualifying sensitive transfer/prompt event targets unapproved app under versioned policy; not_evaluable if classification or event-time state absent
Deduplication: tenant + application + data class/action family + root correlation/window

Required coverage: upstream password detector coverage and whitelist/exception state known

Deduplication: tenant + affected canonical account/app + behavior + generation
Action: Remediate credential or approve scoped expiring exception
Availability: Legacy signals available; detector semantics external

Required coverage: source profile and expected scope/cadence configured

Deduplication: tenant + source installation + scope + stale generation

Required coverage: raw preservation and rejection store healthy

Deduplication: tenant + source family + rejection class + window

Required coverage: required native source healthy and field declared observable
Exact logic: Open when material activity lacks required attribution fields despite healthy capable source; not_evaluable when source cannot observe them

Required coverage: command/effect telemetry and eligible observer configured

Required coverage: both status tables readable in one fenced reconciliation

Deduplication: tenant + legacy finding/event ID + inconsistency generation

Exact logic: Fail gate/open operator finding when member delta cannot be explained by approved dedup/merge/rejection/definition change
